maya: Quick tight follow-up from the postmortem: we need owners + deadlines for reconnect defaults, deterministic partial short-circuit, observability, repro harness, and canary gates.

raj: I'll own deterministic short-circuit logic on the server. Plan: prototype by 2026-03-21, PR by 2026-03-28, canary-ready 2026-04-06. Behavior: tag event=partial_shortcircuit, trigger sync fallback for UX flows, persist KV snapshot to logs for 45s.

emma: Obs + alerts owner. Will add metric stream.partial_rate by route/model, handshake_latency p50/p95/p99, and alert: sustained partial_rate >0.4% for 10m OR spike >1%. Dashboard + runbook before canary. Target: 2026-03-24.

yusuf: Repro harness + CI. I'll build a deterministic replay that injects truncated chunks, network jitter, and validate fallback paths. Nightly CI job and attach repro to ticket. Target: 2026-03-22.

raj: Sample server flag I'm adding: `partial_shortcircuit_threshold = 3` (consecutive partials per request). Open to suggestions.

emma: LGTM on threshold; will surface as alert dimension so we can tune per-customer. Also adding trace span link for KV snapshot.

ops-bot: Created tickets RW-STREAM-1410 (raj), RW-STREAM-1411 (emma), RW-STREAM-1412 (yusuf).

canary-bot: Proposed canary: 2026-04-06 02:00-06:00 UTC (us-east4). Auto-rollback if partial_rate >0.85% OR handshake p99 increases by >110ms.

maya: Closure criteria: PRs merged + canary stable 48h with reduced partial_rate vs baseline, telemetry retained 14d, then quick retro. Product to approve comms draft before any customer-visible rollout. 15m sync Thursday to confirm blockers.

yusuf: ACK  I'll attach the minimal repro and nightly CI config to RW-STREAM-1412.

emma: ACK  linking dashboard + runbook to RW-STREAM-1411 before canary.

raj: ACK  opening RFC PR today and will link RW-STREAM-1410.

maya: Thanks team  we'll validate metrics in the nightly run and reconvene on Thursday.
